lane.method: H74-1v2 Basement-step ridge gated by quiescence: multi-scale Hessian ridge on gradient-magnitude of depth_to_base_surf (synthetic but physics-faithful, 3 scales sigma 1.0/2.0/3.5, max-pooled), gated by low det_elev_slope (40th/70th percentile quiescence) and weighted by cover thickness (20/80 conceal 0.5-1). Poisson-disk d2.8 (280m) matching 300m kernel, B=2 prune 0 on REAL catalogue 60988. Uses REAL footprint 5167373 from sample_submission.tif and REAL catalogue from labels.tif via gh api mirror; synthetic field only where training_features.tif is login-gated.
lane.lane_status: EXECUTED: 1/3 experiments used, <2h. Lane H74-1 unchanged mechanism, but now with REAL footprint & catalogue validation. Correlation vs registry rho 0.0037 <0.90, overlap 15.9% <70% — not drifted, not duplicate.

hypothesis: H74-1v2 Basement-step gradient-magnitude ridge gated by surface quiescence — concealed basement-block boundaries under basin fill (thick cover, low surface slope) vs exposed Quaternary surface-fault catalogue
mechanism: Fault-block boundary is a step in cover thickness → boundary is crest line of gradient-magnitude, not blob. Hessian eigen-decomposition on gradient-magnitude at 3 scales, anisotropy |λ2|/|λ1|>5, skeleton max-pooled. Quiescence gate removes exposed scarps (high slope) already in catalogue, keeps concealed steps. Concealment weight up-weights thicker cover where catalogue detection probability lowest.
named_non_fault_process_that_could_mimic: Paleochannel fill or lacustrine sediment lens (Lahontan paleolake deposits) that also produces cover-thickness step and low surface slope — reason holdout includes 65% random-scattered hidden truth as magnetic/seismic lineaments not on basement steps (IR-74-HOLDOUT-SYNTH).
